From CI it surfaces the test's distinct failure modes from history and pulls evidence for one; locally it reads the run's own trace, snapshot, and logs. Either way it reasons to a falsifiable root cause with the engineer and lands on a test fix, a product-bug issue, or an accepted-flake note. Do…

posit-dev-positron-drive-positron.description: Launch Positron dev server in an isolated, disposable profile and control the Electron workbench. Use to reproduce UI bugs, verify UI changes, inspect the DOM, take screenshots, interact with the workbench, or attach a debugger without first writing an end-to-end test. Do not use to provide a persistent app instance for a person; use the launch-positron command for that. Only runs when a person invokes it explicitly.

posit-dev-positron-drive-positron-web.description: Start Positron Web from source and control it with browser automation. Use for web-only bugs, browser-specific behavior, accessibility-tree inspection, console or network diagnostics, and changes that specifically require the web workbench. Prefer drive-positron for ordinary desktop UI verification.

posit-dev-positron-e2e-failure-analyzer.description: Analyze e2e test failures from a GitHub Actions run. Provide a run ID or URL to download reports, extract traces/screenshots/logs, identify root causes, and get suggested actions. Works with both posit-dev/positron and posit-dev/positron-builds repos.

posit-dev-positron-exploratory-test.description: Explore a running Positron instance as a real user to find genuine problems in a change you just made. Use when asked to exploratorily test, QA, manually test, or poke at a branch, PR, or feature through the real UI. This is discovery testing against the live app to find bugs, NOT writing automated tests; use author-e2e-tests or author-vitest-tests for that. Worth its cost for a user-visible behavior change, not for a refactor or a typo fix. Only runs when a person invokes it explicitly.

posit-dev-positron-vs-sessions-fix-ci.description: Fix the failed CI checks for the current session. Use when the user requests a CI fix via the Fix Checks button in the Changes toolbar.

posit-dev-positron-merge-upstream-vscode.description: This skill should be used when merging upstream changes from vscode-server into the Positron IDE repository. Invoke it when the git repository contains the conflicted changes from an upstream merge.

posit-dev-positron-pete-local.description: Preview the test-coverage verdict PETE will post, locally, before a PR exists. This skill replays the same rubric and file classification against your working tree (committed + uncommitted + untracked changes vs the merge-base with the default branch) and renders the verdict in-session -- it posts nothing and needs no network or gh. posit-dev-positron-positron-intake-rotat.description: Work Positron intake rotation duty - triage the no-status issue queue, discussions nobody at Posit has replied to, and Positron Escalations (PSTRNESC) Jira tickets that sit with engineering. posit-dev-positron-positron-issue-creato.description: This skill should be used when drafting GitHub issues for the Positron repository. The skill prepares issues for manual submission by the user. Use this skill when the user asks to draft or prepare an issue for Positron.

posit-dev-positron-pr-test-checker.description: Grade whether a Positron PR has adequate test coverage. Evaluates new tests in the PR, checks existing coverage for changed source, and suggests concrete additions when coverage is insufficient. Used by the pr-test-checker GitHub Action.

posit-dev-positron-prune-ci-images.description: Audit old container images in the posit-dev GHCR registry and delete them in a reviewed batch. Produces a review list of every positron-<os>* / positron-postgres-* image version older than a cutoff (default 90 days), excluding anything a live tag or multi-arch manifest still points at; the human deletes rows they want to keep, then this drives the batch delete. posit-dev-positron-vs-sessions-sync-upst.description: Update a stale session branch by rebasing onto the latest origin. Use when the upstream has moved significantly and the session needs to catch up, resolving conflicts by preserving upstream changes and adapting session work to fit.

posit-dev-positron-vs-sessions-troublesh.description: Investigate unexpected behavior in the current Copilot agent session by analyzing its event log. posit-dev-positron-extensions-copilot-as.description: Investigate unexpected chat agent behavior by analyzing direct debug logs in JSONL files. posit-dev-positron-update-ci-images.description: Long-running orchestration to rebuild every Positron CI image (ubuntu24_04, rocky_8, rocky_9, debian, openSUSE15_6, SLES15_6, and postgres — each as a multi-arch amd64+arm64 manifest) at one new tag. The tag names the Node, primary Python and primary R versions baked into the images (`<node>-py<python>-r<r>`). Bumps whichever of the three changed, repoints every consumer at the new tag, dispatches the build workflows on the PR branch with bounded concurrency, monitors the runs, auto-fixes failures and retries, and leaves the PR open for human review once all 7 builds are green.

posit-dev-positron-vs-sessions-update-pr.description: Update the pull request for the current session. Use when the user wants to push new changes to an existing PR.

posit-dev-positron-vs-sessions-update-sk.description: Create or update repository skills and instructions when major learnings are discovered during a session.
